text: Data provision is adequate for Fund surveillance, with remaining data gaps mostly pertaining to the "OFI residual" segment. Under the Data Adequacy Assessment Rating, Ireland receives an overall rating of A and a median rating of A, with Monetary and Financial Statistics rated B while five sectors receive A. Ireland has subscribed to the Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS) since July 1996. The CBI should continue to work together with the CSO and other regulators to reduce data gaps for non-bank entities and identify foreign and domestic linkages.
